description: Enhanced edge cases for plain-text URL cleaning: no-URL text, empty/missing input errors, duplicate URLs, http scheme, multiple heterogeneous URLs, and decode_url with surrounding prose.

input.text: Just some plain prose without any link in it at all.

cases.expected_output:
cleaned_text=Just some plain prose without any link in it at all.
url_count=0

input.text: first https://www.example.com?utm_x=1 then again https://www.example.com?utm_x=1 end

cases.expected_output:
cleaned_text=first https://www.example.com then again https://www.example.com end
url_count=2
url[0]=https://www.example.com
url[1]=https://www.example.com

cleaned_text=A https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salt plus https://twitter.com/foo/status/9999 plus https://www.example.com done
url_count=3
url[0]=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salt
url[1]=https://twitter.com/foo/status/9999
url[2]=https://www.example.com
